structured_output.summary: The two-line wiring correctly registers create_agent_router(service) after all existing @app routes and before the StaticFiles catch-all mount, so agent endpoints resolve ahead of the SPA fallback. The single global boundary middleware applies uniformly to all routes regardless of registration order, so Host/Origin/JSON enforcement already covers the new router without any special-casing needed. The new test exercises the real create_app() (not a bare router), forces both agent sources unavailable via env-var/monkeypatch injection (not mocking catalog/bindings logic), and verifies same-origin 200, cross-origin 403, and that the OpenAPI schema exposes only GET on /api/agents/sources. Router construction is additive/local (per stated constraints) and does not start any background process, so no lifecycle regression.
